hooks.name: asset-licence-and-budget
hooks.description: When Kiro adds an asset, enforce the size budget and log its source and licence.

action.prompt: A new asset was added under public/assets/. (1) Check its file size against the budgets in tech.md (textures <= 1024 px except the kelir cloth, total initial download <= 15 MB) and compress or resize if needed. (2) Add a row to ASSETS.md with file path, source, author and licence. Only original, CC0 or procedurally generated assets are allowed; if the source or licence is unknown, stop and ask me before using it.
